responsibility: Implements dynamic loading and registration support for Rust procedural macros in GCC. This file wraps loaded bang, attribute, and custom-derive proc-macro entry points with front-end node IDs, provides bridge callbacks that convert strings into proc_macro token streams or literals using GCC’s lexer/token converters, uses dlopen/dlsym to load the shared library and register those callbacks, locates the exported proc-macro declaration array symbol, and returns the discovered procedural macro descriptors to the expansion subsystem.
same_name_distinction: Defines the runtime implementation behind this proc-macro interface: it constructs the wrapper objects declared in the header, performs dlopen/dlsym-based loading of proc-macro shared libraries, registers token/literal conversion callbacks with the loaded library, and fetches the exported proc-macro declaration array symbol. Unlike the header, it contains the executable loading and bridge logic.
